instruction: Have Glitch plug the data shard into his deck and crack whatever is on it.

target.reason: The instruction wants Glitch to use the data shard — plug it into his deck and crack its contents — not merely hold it, be somewhere, or say something. The page offers no verb for using or cracking an item (only depart, say, say-to, whisper, offer, accept, refuse), and none of the available end states (holding an item, being in a room, having said something) represents the shard having been cracked. Even getting glitch to hold the data-shard would not show him plugging it in or breaking whatever is on it.
